target_region.prompt: Where are your users located? (default applied)
target_region.design_consequence: All resources deploy in us-east-1; Bedrock model availability checked for this region

availability.prompt: Detected: Cloud SQL ZONAL → single-AZ availability
availability.design_consequence: single-az drives RDS single-AZ vs Multi-AZ vs Aurora selection

cpu_architecture.prompt: All compute services are Graviton-ready (default applied)
cpu_architecture.design_consequence: Graviton instance families for EC2 and RDS

cost_optimization.prompt: How aggressively should we right-size your AWS design versus your current capacity?
cost_optimization.design_consequence: aggressive: measured rule with no cap above the family minimum where the inventory carries utilization; web-steady exempted (known upcoming load change)
